reponse:
The root cause was a full disk on Kafka broker ingest-kafka-2, which went read-only at 09:38 UTC after infra PR #221 removed size-based retention (7-day time-based only) [2]. The consumers stalled, and the outage lasted 2h47m with events delayed but none lost [2]. Slack confirms the disk was at 100% and the broker read-only [3].

The first hypothesis, the batch size increase in PR #388, was wrong. The agent suspected it [1], but the lag kept climbing after the revert [1][3]. The postmortem calls #388 a red herring, and the change was re-applied [5].
